name: sandpiper
description: A self-hosted, real-time collaborative workspace: block editor, nested pages and databases, with an MCP server for AI apps. Runs on Cloudflare free plan.
author: Dennis Sagayanathan

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n cloud,web -c blue,green "wrangler dev --port 8799 --local-upstream localhost:5199 --upstream-protocol http --var LOCAL_DEV:1" "vite"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n signin,cloud,web -c magenta,blue,green "node scripts/dev-signin.mjs" "wrangler dev --port 8799 --local-upstream localhost:5199 --upstream-protocol http --var LOCAL_DEV:1 --var OAUTH_MOCK_URL:http://127.0.0.1:9911 --var GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:local-demo" "vite"
